reference_commit: cesm3_0_alpha (ESCOMP) + instrument/cism-dumps (fork superproject a95fe50; source_cism b33660b6, cism wrapper submodule 142a4cb = cismwrap_3_00_002; only the 4 source files + cism_dump_mod.F90 are modified; the 2026-11-03 thermo extension of cism_dump_thermo - dttem/dissip/sigma/stagsigma columns - is committed at all three levels, not pushed; the 2026-11-05 DIVA neighbour-stencil extension that adds the cism_velo_nbr.csv trace is committed at the fork superproject db624ec with the cism wrapper bump 76d170d (components/cism = cismwrap_3_00_002-4-g2a8316d), not pushed)
description: CISM boundary traces from an instrumented T1850Gg CESM run (PLAN.md M4), default-gated by dump_cism=.false. and enabled in run 2 only: (a) D-boundary pointwise laws - pseudo-plastic basal sliding law (HO_BABC_PSEUDO_PLASTIC_OLD in glissade_calcbeta: bed -> phi ramp -> tanphi -> tau_c=tanphi*N -> beta=tau_c/(u0^q*speed^(1-q)), one row per traced vertex and Picard iteration), Bueler & van Pelt (2015) effective pressure law (HO_EFFECPRESS_BWAT_BVP: relative_bwat clamp -> N = N0*(delta*P/N0)^s*10^((e0/Cc)*(1-s)) capped at overburden, one row per traced cell with bwat>0 per solve), Paterson-Budd flow law (FLWA_PATERSON_BUDD in glissade_flow_factor: T*=clamp(temp-pmptemp,-50,0)+273.15, flwa = E*a*exp(-Q/(R*T*)) with the (a,Q/R) pair switching at tempcor>=-10, one row per traced cell and layer); (b) I boundaries - cap imports/exports around glad_gcm (tsfc/qsmb exactly as consumed, topo/hflx/rofi/rofl/ice_covered exactly as produced), and entry/exit state of the three solved subassemblies: higher-order velocity solve (glissade_velo_higher_solve, DIVA = which_ho_approx 4; masks, geometry, eus, effecpress_stag, driving/basal stresses, 2-D and 3-D velocities), prognostic temperature solve (glissade_therm_driver; profile temp_0..upn, waterfrac, bpmp/btemp/bmlt), and thickness/tracer evolution (glissade_thickness_tracer_solve; thck/topo/usrf/lsrf/artm/acab/bmlt/bwat + velocity and temperature profiles).

regenerate.note: Model source root is the fork worktree stage1/EqESM-cesm-cism (branch instrument/cism-dumps); CIME scripts come from the pristine checkout stage1/cesm/cime. Two runs of the SAME case/exe: run 1 dump-off (reference, run_ref_dumpoff), run 2 dump-on (instrumented, run/; user_nl_cism + user_nl_cism_gris toggle dump_cism and resubmit; DOUT_S=FALSE so h0 files stay in run/). Both runs are startup runs from the same initial conditions, so the dumps cover the same 2-year trajectory. Dump CSVs land in stage1/dumps/cism/ (set by dump_dir in user_nl_cism); full dumps are gitignored and regenerable; each run takes ~1 min wall. RERUN protocol (2026-11-02): dump-module fixes 1-3 - 400-char header buffers truncated the trailing column names of the state traces, the a5 phase format padded 'exit' with a leading space, and traced cells were switched from the static active-grid mask (which picked 32 ice-free coastal cells with all-zero physics) to the initial ice coverage ice_covered = thck > 0 - were followed by the intermediate pair 11978998 (dump-off) / 11979075 (dump-on; run 1 old-exe snapshot preserved as run_ref_dumpoff_oldexe; its h0i/restart are bit-identical to the intermediate-exe dump-off run, confirming the rebuild changed nothing). FINAL cycle: defect 4 - the (-2,-2) index-space offset, an INSTRUMENTATION bug, not a CISM bug: the model's local arrays are halo-indexed (nhalo=2, model%general%ewn/nsn = local dims 80x145) while the cap arrays (qsmb, ice_covered) are owned/global-indexed (76x141), and the trace enumerated cells from the cap's global ice_covered but read the model arrays at those indices, shifting every model-side value by (-2,-2) (e.g. traced cell (25,11) dumped global cell (23,9)'s thck/topg). cism_dump_init now takes the model local dims, computes off = (local - owned)/2 = 2, and reads model arrays at (i+off_i, j+off_j); dump_cell_ix translates pointwise call-site local indices back to the traced global cell. Also removed the trailing comma dump_reals emitted after each row, which then exposed defect 5: the cap trace wrote ice_covered after the dump_reals block without a separator (the old trailing comma had doubled as the delimiter), so every cap row had 14 fields against a 15-column header - fixed by writing '(",",es26.17)' for ice_covered and verified with a standalone driver. Final rebuilds (build 8 = cap-comma fix, build 9 = transport-temp fix; both BUILD_EXIT=0, nm shows the cism_dump_mod symbols): defect 6, an off-by-one in the transport trace - it wrote temp(1..upn),temp(0) into the header slots temp_000..temp_upn, shifting every level by one and landing the surface value temp(0) in the bed slot temp_upn; fixed to write temp(0..upn) in vertical order (level 0 = surface, level upn = bed) and verified with the standalone driver before the rerun. FINAL pair: run 1 = 11979644 (dump-off, COMPLETED exit 0:0; valid reference for the final exe - the dump module is I/O-only and dump-off outputs were verified bit-identical across rebuilds), run 2 = 11980950 (dump-on, COMPLETED exit 0:0, final exe; 11979768 was the same exe minus the cap-comma fix and 11980002 minus the transport-temp fix); intermediate snapshots preserved (run_ref_dumpoff_exeB, dumps/cism_oldexe_20261102).

dump_files.cism_cap.csv: cism_step,time(hours),cap_step,i,j,gi,gj,phase(import|export),tsfc,qsmb,topo,hflx,rofi,rofl,ice_covered - GLC cap boundary around glad_gcm (glc_RunMod): import rows with tsfc [degC] and qsmb [kg/m2/s] exactly as consumed by CISM (after the cap import_fields processing: tsfc converted by -tkfrz and clamped to 0 where the raw mediator value was < -250 degC); export rows with topo [m], hflx [W/m2, sign convention as computed, -ucondflx, see bugs.md #32], rofi/rofl [kg/m2/s = mm H2O/s], ice_covered [-] exactly as produced by glad_set_output_fields; export columns are 0 at import and import columns 0 at export
dump_files.cism_velo.csv: cism_step,time(yr),cap_step,i,j,gi,gj,phase(entry|exit),ice_mask,floating_mask,land_mask,f_ground_cell,f_ground,thck,topg,usrf,stagthck,stagtopg,eus,effecpress_stag,taudx,taudy,btractx,btracty,uvel_2d,vvel_2d,uvel_001..uvel_nlayers,vvel_001..vvel_nlayers - entry/exit of glissade_velo_higher_solve (DIVA): entry after masks/effecpress available and before the nonlinear solve, exit right before the final unit scaling, so velocities are solver-internal m/yr in both phases; staggered columns (f_ground, effecpress_stag, stresses, velocities) at the vertex (i,j) = NE corner of the traced cell (clamped to the staggered-grid bounds on the north/east edge); at entry the velocity columns hold the previous-step (or initial) values
dump_files.cism_velo_nbr.csv: cism_step,time(yr),cap_step,i,j,gi,gj,phase(entry|exit),usrf_sw,thck_sw,ice_mask_sw,land_mask_sw,usrf_se,thck_se,ice_mask_se,land_mask_se,usrf_nw,thck_nw,ice_mask_nw,land_mask_nw,usrf_ne,thck_ne,ice_mask_ne,land_mask_ne,sigma_001..sigma_011,efvs_001..efvs_010,efvs_q1_001..efvs_q1_010,efvs_q2_001..efvs_q2_010,efvs_q3_001..efvs_q3_010,efvs_q4_001..efvs_q4_010,omega_k_001..omega_k_011,omega,omega_sw,omega_se,omega_nw,omega_ne,stag_omega,stag_omega_k_001..stag_omega_k_011,beta_eff_x,beta_eff_y,beta_internal,stag_theta_slope_x,stag_theta_slope_y,stag_diva_slope_factor_x,stag_diva_slope_factor_y,dusrf_dx,dusrf_dy - 4-cell neighbour stencil of the NE-corner vertex of each traced cell (SW = the traced cell, then SE, NW, NE) plus the DIVA internal state, entry/exit of glissade_velo_higher_solve: at entry the stencil geometry (usrf/thck/masks) is current but the DIVA columns are 0; at exit they hold the compute_integrals_diva outputs (omega_k_001..011 = the interface-to-bed cumulative integral of sig_mid*thck*(1/4)sum_p 1/efvs_qp, omega = the trapezoid sigma integral of omega_k, omega_sw/se/nw/ne = the four stencil-cell omegas, stag_omega = their vertex mean, stag_omega_k_001..011 = the interface integrals staggered to the vertex), the layer effective viscosities (efvs_001..010 = arithmetic quad-point mean, efvs_q1..q4 per layer = the quadrature-point values, 0 on ice-free cells), the DIVA solve state (beta_eff_x, beta_eff_y, beta_internal), and the vertex slope correction (stag_theta_slope_x/y, stag_diva_slope_factor_x/y = F, dusrf_dx/dy). ADDED 2026-11-05 for the stage-2 DIVA velocity lane (row 6): the original cism_velo.csv carries only the traced cell plus vertex scalars, while the DIVA pointwise laws need the vertex stencil (hybrid-margin dusrf_dx/dy, 4-cell stagthck, theta from the vertex gradient of z_mean, the F slope factors) and the quadrature-point viscosities that enter the omega_k integrand. 256 rows = 32 cells x 4 steps x 2 phases; rerun job 12118489 COMPLETED exit 0:0; validated by stage1/analysis/extract_cism_velo_test_rows.py (all pointwise laws on the 128 exit rows) and pinned in stage2/cism_velo.esm
dump_files.cism_thermo.csv: cism_step,time(yr),cap_step,i,j,gi,gj,phase(entry|exit),dttem [s],ice_mask,floating_mask,thck,topg,lsrf,eus,artm,bwat,bheatflx,bfricflx,bhydroflx,f_ground_cell,temp_000..temp_upn,waterfrac_001..waterfrac_nlayers,dissip_001..dissip_nlayers [deg/s],sigma_001..sigma_upn,stagsigma_001..stagsigma_upn-1,bpmp,btemp_ground,btemp_float,bmlt_ground - entry/exit of glissade_therm_driver (TEMP_PROGNOSTIC): entry temp = previous-step profile with basal outputs 0; exit has all outputs final (bmlt_ground [m/yr] positive = melt); waterfrac is 0 for TEMP_PROGNOSTIC. Both call sites (glissade_therm.F90:727, 1331) updated; rerun job 12053984 COMPLETED 2026-11-03; old dumps backed up to /scratch.local/ctessum/cism_dumps_backup/
dump_files.cism_transport.csv: cism_step,time(yr),cap_step,i,j,gi,gj,phase(entry|exit),ice_mask,floating_mask,thck,topg,usrf,lsrf,artm,acab,bmlt_ground,bmlt_float,bwat,uvel_001..uvel_upn,vvel_001..vvel_upn,temp_000..temp_upn - entry/exit of glissade_thickness_tracer_solve (EVOL_INC_REMAP + SMB application): acab [m/yr ice] as applied (stored m/s ice field x scyr), bmlt_* [m/yr], velocities at the NE-corner vertex (stored m/s field x scyr, upn layers), temperature profile temp_000..temp_upn in vertical order (level 0 = surface, level upn = bed; an earlier off-by-one that wrote temp(1..upn),temp(0) was fixed in the final module)
dump_files.cism_basal_traction.csv: cism_step,time(yr),cap_step,i,j,gi,gj,velo_iter,u,v,speed,bed,phi,tanphi,N,tau_c,q,u0,beta - pseudo-plastic law (HO_BABC_PSEUDO_PLASTIC_OLD), one row per traced vertex and Picard iteration of the velocity solve; velo_iter counts law evaluations within the current solve (reset at each velo entry; the effecpress trace is evaluation 1 and the calcbeta iterations follow); bed = topg(i,j) - eus with CELL-CENTER topg, not stagtopg (a known quirk of this deprecated law); speed = sqrt(u^2+v^2+0.01^2) m/yr; beta [Pa/(m/yr)]
dump_files.cism_effecpress.csv: cism_step,time(yr),cap_step,i,j,gi,gj,bwat,bwat_till_max,relative_bwat,overburden,N_0,effecpress_delta,e_0,C_c,N - Bueler & van Pelt (2015) law (HO_EFFECPRESS_BWAT_BVP), one row per traced cell with bwat>0, once per velocity solve; N = min(N0*(delta*P/N0)^s*10^((e0/Cc)*(1-s)), P) with s = clamp(bwat/bwat_till_max,0,1) and P = rhoi*g*thck; the floating-mask zeroing after the law is not reflected
dump_files.cism_flowlaw.csv: cism_step,time(yr),cap_step,i,j,gi,gj,layer,temp,pmptemp,tempcor,E,flwa - Paterson-Budd flow law (FLWA_PATERSON_BUDD), one row per (traced cell, layer 1..nlayers): tempcor = clamp(temp-pmptemp,-50,0), flwa [Pa^-n s^-1] = E*a*exp(-Q/(R*(tempcor+273.15))) with (a,Q/R) = (1.733e3, 139e3/8.314 K) for tempcor >= -10 and (3.613e-13, 60e3/8.314 K) below (glimmer_physcon arrmlh/arrmll/actenh/actenl/gascon); E = 1.0 (which_ho_flow_enhancement_factor=0)

traced_domain.pet: 0 only (dump_pet gate; TOTALPES=1 so the whole grid)
traced_domain.cells: first 32 cells with initial ice coverage (ice_covered = thck > 0 from glad_get_initial_outputs, the first 32 ice-covered cells in (j,i) order, i fastest), enumerated at cism_dump_init (dump_first_cells=32); the dumped context columns i,j,gi,gj are the traced GLOBAL cells (gi=i, gj=j for the single-PE config) and the model arrays are read at the halo-shifted local indices (i+off_i, j+off_j) with off = (local dims - owned dims)/2 = 2 (nhalo=2); cell-centered columns at the traced cell, staggered columns at the vertex (i,j) = NE corner clamped to ewn-1/nsn-1; the static active-grid mask was rejected because its first cells are ice-free coastal cells with all-zero physics
traced_domain.steps: first 8 CISM steps and first 8 coupling steps (dump_first_steps=8); the 2-year run actually produces 4 CISM steps and 2 cap steps, so every step is traced
traced_domain.steps_note: basal_traction has one row per (cell, Picard iteration) per step (velo_iter chain); effecpress rows only where bwat > 0 at solve time - the gland20 initial state has bwat = 0 everywhere and the 2-year cold-base run produces no basal melt, so the effecpress trace is legitimately EMPTY in this run (the law is pinned from the source formula and the trace machinery fires when bwat > 0); flowlaw has nlayers=10 rows per (cell, step); the initial velocity solve at glad_initialize_instance precedes cism_dump_init and is not traced.

checks.bit_identical_outputs: instrumented run's cism.h0i (3 files, annual) + cism.gris.r restart differ from the reference run only in :title/:date_created/:history-style attributes - all data variables identical, so the dump code changes nothing when enabled (stage1/analysis/compare_cism.py; run_ref_dumpoff vs run)
checks.basal_law: speed = sqrt(u^2+v^2+0.01^2), phi(bed) piecewise ramp (5..40 deg over bed -300..700 m, clamped), tanphi, tau_c = tanphi*N, beta = tau_c/(u0^q*speed^(1-q)) all hold to round-off (rtol 1e-9) on every row, with q/u0 taken from the dumped columns; cross-checked bed == velo topg - eus and N == velo effecpress_stag
checks.effecpress_law: relative_bwat = clamp(bwat/2,0,1) and N = min(N0*(delta*P/N0)^s*10^((e0/Cc)*(1-s)), P) hold to round-off on every row; overburden cross-checked == rhoi*g*thck (velo entry). 0 rows in this 2-year run (bwat=0 everywhere: gland20 initial state has no basal water and the cold base melts nothing), so the validator accepts the absent trace as expected and the law is additionally pinned from the source formula (glissade_basal_traction.F90:953-994) with the glide_types defaults (bwat_till_max=2.0 m, N_0=1000 Pa, e_0=0.69, C_c=0.12, effecpress_delta=0.02) that the dumped columns would carry
checks.flowlaw: flwa = E*a*exp(-Q/(R*(tempcor+273.15))) with the (a,Q/R) pair switching at tempcor >= -10 holds to round-off on every (cell, layer) row; the traced temp equals the transport-exit profile layer by layer (the flwa is recomputed at the diagnostic solve, after transport and after glissade_cleanup_icefree_cells - for cells that became ice-free in the step, temp = min(artm, 0))
checks.smb_chain: transport-exit acab [m/yr ice] = cap-import qsmb [kg/m2/s] x SMB_FAC to round-off, SMB_FAC = 31536 x (1000/917) = 34390.40348964013 (31536 = tstep_mbal 8760 hr x 3600/1000 -> m w.e.; x1000/917 = rhow/rhoi in glide_set_acab; validated against glad_main/glad_mbal_coupling/glad_timestep source), EXCEPT where the SMB would remove ice from an ice-free cell: acab = 0 where thck <= 0 and acab < 0 (glad_timestep.F90:180) or thck <= 0 and topg < eus (ice-free ocean; none of the traced cells), with the zeroing thickness = the same step's transport-ENTRY thck; acab is also constant through the transport solve (entry == exit)
checks.bpmp: thermo-exit bpmp = -rhoi*g*pmlt*thck (pmlt = 9.7456e-8 K/Pa) on grounded cells with thck > thklim_temp = 1.0 m (the thermal ice mask, glide_types default not overridden), bpmp = 0 on floating cells and on grounded cells with thck <= thklim_temp (glissade_therm.F90:796-804)
checks.chaining: solve order inside glissade_tstep is thermo (before transport) -> thickness_tracer_solve (transport + SMB) -> calving/cleanup -> diagnostic velocity solve, so: within a step, thermo entry AND exit thck/artm/bwat == transport entry, and velo entry thck/usrf == transport exit; across steps, transport entry(s+1) thck/usrf/lsrf == transport exit(s) exactly and velo entry(s+1) uvel_2d/vvel_2d == velo exit(s) to rtol 1e-12 (the stored m/s field is rescaled to solver-internal m/yr at each solve entry, which can differ from the exit values in the last ulp); the temperature profile is advected by transport and untouched until the next thermal solve, so thermo entry(s+1) temp(l) == transport exit(s) temp(l) for all l, EXCEPT in cells that became ice-free during step s (transport-exit thck = 0), where glissade_cleanup_icefree_cells (called after the transport-exit trace) resets the whole column to min(artm, 0); artm/acab are boundary fields constant within a year (they legitimately change at the year boundary, step 2 -> 3)
checks.row_counts: state traces 32 cells x 4 steps x 2 phases = 256 rows each; cap 32 x 2 cap steps x 2 phases = 128; flowlaw 32 x 4 x 10 layers = 1280; basal >= 32x4 (one per iteration); effecpress <= 32x4; no blank lines; traced-cell sets identical across all 7 traces
